lead.headline: High Point is 4-0 and rates 70th
lead.deck: The Panthers have beaten Liberty, Washington State and Southern Utah by a combined 56 points. No one else in the league is in our top 180.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Big South, nine schools across the Carolinas and Virginia, from Farmville and Radford to Rock Hill and Charleston. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
High Point is 4-0 and rates 70th in our model. The Panthers beat Liberty 72-57 on a neutral floor, Washington State 83-71 and Southern Utah 88-59.
UNC Asheville lost 75-74 at Georgia Tech on Saturday, three days after winning 73-70 at West Georgia.
Longwood (187th) is 3-2 and won 80-75 in overtime over North Carolina Central.
Winthrop is 0-4, and three of the losses came by five points or fewer.

column.title: Three numbers from the first two weeks
body: **70.** High Point's national rank in our model, the highest in the Big South by more than 100 spots.
